entities.summary: Lyndon Robert Rive is a South African-American businessman known as the co-founder of SolarCity, and its CEO until 2016. SolarCity was a provider of photovoltaic systems and related services. By the early 2010s, it became the largest residential solar installer in the United States. Rive co-founded SolarCity with his brother Peter in 2006.
